source.name: AFC - Aramco named Official Global Supporter of AFC Asian Cup Saudi Arabia 2027
source.note: Official Global Supporter plus naming of the Al Khobar venue as Aramco Stadium - the first venue-naming partnership in AFC history.

note: Second-tier supporter of the tournament; Aramco Stadium is also home of Aramco-owned Al-Qadsiah and operated by Aramco (Sportcal).
